title: Offline Pix check result
summary: Shows the fields found in a shared Pix code or key and the existing scam warning. The code name is unverified; the final check is the recipient name shown by the bank.

status.description: Exactly PixCheck.Status; a valid checksum proves format only.

dynamic.description: A dynamic BR Code has a charge location instead of a static key.

singleUse.description: The code declares single-use; this is not payment status.

chargeHost.description: Host only from Code.urlHost. Plain text; never fetched or opened.

name.description: Name entered by the code author, not a verified identity.

amount.description: Decimal amount from the code; format locally in BRL without binary rounding.

txid.description: Identifier, absent when the payload uses ***.

types.description: Every matching key type, in registry order; do not pick one type when a span is ambiguous.

sourceIndex.description: The provider item index; images may produce several checked reports.

code.description: First BR Code in this input, exactly as returned by PixCheck.check.

keys.description: Other Pix key spans, in reference text order.

warningKind.description: ScamWarningKind from the shared rules, excluding pixCode and pixKey; absent when there is none.

results.description: Checked reports in receive order, without a server lookup.

accountAvailable.description: Only controls the optional send-to-chat action in the containing app; never gates the check.

isHandingOff.description: True while the explicit pending preview is being saved.

handoffFailed.description: Shows a generic retry error; never sends automatically.

close.effect: Deletes the local inputs/results and closes the share route or completes the extension.

sendToChat.effect: Only after an explicit tap, offers an editable preview and a chat chooser for the current signed-in account; the user must select the chat and tap Send before any content leaves the device.

retryHandoff.effect: Retries saving the same pending preview once per tap, without creating a duplicate send or requiring the check to run again.

notes: Render every report using existing bipe_pix_check_* strings. The result must remain usable offline and signed out; accountAvailable=false hides Send to a chat. Always show bipe_pix_check_private and end with bipe_pix_check_bank_name, including bad CRC, malformed and nothing-found results.

Fields, in order: Name in the code, City, Amount (bipe_pix_check_amount_open when absent), static Key or dynamic Charge issued by, Description, Identifier. Omit other missing fields. The dynamic charge host is plain text with bipe_pix_check_code_dynamic; never dereference it. Never use a verified seal, green safety approval, payment-completed mark, bank-launch action or phase 2 verified-key lookup.

For a valid static code show bipe_pix_check_code_title, fields and bipe_pix_check_name_hint. For badCrc show bipe_pix_check_code_bad_crc before any parsed fields, using the caution/error treatment; parsed values remain explicitly unverified. For malformed show bipe_pix_check_code_malformed and no missing/made-up fields. A correct CRC alone never proves that payment is safe.

Keys use bipe_pix_check_keys_title and the existing key-type strings. When types has several entries, join their localized labels with bipe_pix_check_key_types_or in reference order. A text with no code/keys shows bipe_pix_check_nothing_found. A rule warning still renders even if no Pix was found.

warningKind comes only from PixCheck.warning and the existing ScamWarningKind string mapping / registries/scam-patterns.json. Use bipe_scam_warning_title and its mapped body; do not repeat pixCode/pixKey generic warnings because the screen explains those already. Test-vectors/scam-warnings.json and scam-detection.json define priority.

The original shared input, not a reformatted or verified-sounding summary, is the editable send preview. On iOS the extension may save this preview locally for the containing app as defined by pix-check-receive; finishing the extension does not imply delivery. A later app-open shows the pending preview outside account-start, then offers chat selection only after sign-in/unlock. If already signed in, explicitly confirm the account before sending. Android uses the same preview/chooser behavior in the app. Cancellation, expired handoff or account change never sends to a remembered room.

Acceptance on both platforms: every pix-check vector; static/dynamic BR Code, bad CRC, malformed code, ambiguous key, no Pix, a warning without Pix; QR image with zero/one/multiple payloads; shared image file versus image object; unsupported/revoked/oversized input; retry and cancellation during decode; two shares back to back; airplane mode and no account; Close causes no network/send; explicit Send requires account, chat choice and final confirmation. No actual bank/account data is needed: use synthetic fixtures.
